invariants_the_batch_preserves.frozen_slot_order: slots executed strictly in ascending slot_number; no reordering, no parallelism across slots
invariants_the_batch_preserves.per_slot_A09: each slot requires its own A-09 decision recorded in phase1-a09-decision-registry.json with state APPROVED_FOR_BOUNDED_FIRST_PARTY_PUBLIC_RESEARCH BEFORE that slot runs; slots 07-24 currently have NO A-09 decision (registry holds only slots 1-5). A slot whose A-09 is NOT_APPROVED terminates truthfully (A-09 NOT_APPROVED) and the batch proceeds to the next slot.
invariants_the_batch_preserves.no_redraw_no_replacement: no slot substitution, no roster edit, no re-run of an already-terminal slot; a slot that reaches any truthful terminal (CONTACT_PHASE_NOT_AUTHORIZED, M2_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, M1_RESEARCH_FAILED, A-09 NOT_APPROVED, exact-host mismatch) is done
invariants_the_batch_preserves.truthful_terminal_progression: each slot advances only through accepted current-runtime predecessors; the coordinator rejects skip / replay / cross-business inputs; the terminal is always CONTACT_PHASE_NOT_AUTHORIZED or an earlier truthful stop
invariants_the_batch_preserves.dormancy_between_slots: after each slot terminates: research-release returns to not_authorized, controlled-egress lease NOT_AUTHORIZED, kill switch re-armed/observed, services remain 0 desired; the next slot's release is a fresh single-use grant
invariants_the_batch_preserves.final_human_review_after_slot_24: no Phase 1 continuation, no M6.6/AI, no contact resolution, no outreach delivery, no benchmarks until the owner reviews the full Slots 07-24 batch output
invariants_the_batch_preserves.cost_ceiling: remains within the ADR-0075 USD 250 authorization

explicitly_out_of_scope_of_this_gate: any change to M1 versions, the minimizer (phase1-minimizer@2), M2 qualification thresholds, the opportunity definition (commercial_hvac.inbound_lead_response_qualification@1), the contact-phase gate, provenance, or minimization/external-use controls
any new container image or Terraform change

what_owner_approval_does_NOT_authorize: Starting any slot before its A-09 decision is recorded APPROVED; deviating from ascending slot order; re-running or replacing any slot; activating any capability listed as out of scope; continuing past slot 24 without owner review.
